comment: Hand-maintained API list prices used by make_cost_summary.py. USD per 1M tokens (MTok), standard pay-as-you-go rates. Re-check each source_url before regenerating; update rates and fetched dates together. These are list prices for comparison only - the project itself ran on a Muse subscription, not per-token billing.

providers.tier_note: Standard mode, pay-as-you-go. Contributor mode is not available for Muse Wonder. The runtime identifies this chat's model as Muse Wonder, so this is the serving model's own published rate card.

Claude Opus 5.5: Anthropic's flagship tier for long-running agentic coding and knowledge work (the pricing page's own description) - the tier an agent run like this one would use. Cache rate below is the cache-READ (hit) rate, 0.05x base input; Anthropic also charges cache writes (1.25x base for 5-minute, 2x for 1-hour), not modelled here. One tier sits above it: Claude Fable 5.1 at $10 input / $50 output / $0.25 cache read.

GPT-6 Astra: OpenAI's flagship model, Standard processing tier. Prompts with more than 272K input tokens are priced at 2x input/cache rates and 1.5x output for the full request (per the official model page); that surcharge is NOT modelled in the headline figures. Cache rate below is the cached-input rate; OpenAI also charges cache writes (1.25x uncached input on this model), not modelled here.
